title: Five Stars for the Sign, But Two For The Packing Job!
text: Five Stars for the Sign, But Two For The Packing Job!. The sign itself is beautiful, and I could hardly wait to hang it up. So disappointed when it arrived bent, however, because it was not protected in the mailing envelope.
